remedy_text: Boil 5-6 fresh Tulsi leaves and 1/2 tsp Mulethi (Licorice) powder in 2 cups of water until reduced to 1 cup. Strain and drink warm twice daily. Perform warm water gargles with a pinch of rock salt.
ayurvedic_note: Pacifies Kapha and Vata doshas, soothes mucosal lining.

dosage.adult: 40-80 ml lukewarm kwath twice daily, 30 min after meals
dosage.child_6_12: 20-40 ml lukewarm kwath once daily after meals
dosage.child_under_6: Not recommended for children under 6 without physician guidance
dosage.elderly: 30-40 ml lukewarm kwath twice daily after meals
dosage.hindi: Din mein 1-2 baar khana khane ke 30 minute baad gunguna piyein

remedy_text: Boil 1/2 tsp Cumin (Jeera) and 1/2 tsp Carom seeds (Ajwain) with a pinch of black salt in 250ml water for 5 minutes. Sip slowly after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Kindles Deepana (digestive fire) and relieves Vata entrapment.

dosage.adult: 100-150 ml warm infusion sipped slowly after major meals
dosage.child_6_12: 50 ml warm infusion once daily after lunch
dosage.child_under_6: 1-2 teaspoons under pediatric supervision
dosage.elderly: 50-100 ml warm infusion after meals
dosage.hindi: Khana khane ke baad din mein 1-2 baar gunguna ghunt-ghunt piyein

remedy_text: Mix 1/4 tsp pure turmeric powder and 1/2 tsp Ashwagandha root powder in 1 cup of warm milk. Consume before sleep.
ayurvedic_note: Rasayana (rejuvenator) and Balya (strength-promoting).

dosage.adult: 1 cup (150-200 ml) warm ksheerapaka at bedtime
dosage.child_6_12: Half cup (80-100 ml) with half dosage of herbs at bedtime
dosage.child_under_6: Plain warm turmeric milk only, avoid Ashwagandha under 6
dosage.elderly: Half cup (100 ml) warm ksheerapaka before sleeping
dosage.hindi: Raat ko sone se pehle 1 cup gungune doodh ke sath lein

remedy_text: Mix 1 tsp fresh Vasa (Adhatoda vasica) leaf juice with 1 tsp raw organic honey. Take twice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Potent bronchodilator and mucolytic herb native to Himalayan foothills.

dosage.adult: 1 teaspoon (5 ml) juice with 1 tsp honey, twice daily after food
dosage.child_6_12: Half teaspoon (2.5 ml) with 1 tsp honey, once daily
dosage.child_under_6: Avoid Vasa in children under 6; consult doctor
dosage.elderly: Half teaspoon twice daily with honey
dosage.hindi: Din mein 1-2 baar khana khane ke baad shahad ke sath lein

remedy_text: Boil 2 gm dry ginger rhizome in water, reduce to one-fourth, and drink 10–20 ml twice daily. Ginger paste can also be applied on forehead for headache.
ayurvedic_note: Stimulates Agni (digestive fire), relieves Kapha-related congestion.

dosage.adult: 10-20 ml warm decoction twice daily before or after food
dosage.child_6_12: 5-10 ml with a little honey once daily
dosage.child_under_6: Not recommended for infants; mild ginger water for ages 3-6
dosage.elderly: 10 ml warm decoction once or twice daily
dosage.hindi: Din mein 1-2 baar 10-20 ml gunguna piyein

remedy_text: Take 1 gm Ajwain powder with black salt in buttermilk twice daily. For sinusitis, apply warm paste over forehead and inhale vapors.
ayurvedic_note: Relieves Vata imbalance, useful in digestive and respiratory complaints.

dosage.adult: 1 gm powder with a glass of spiced buttermilk twice daily with meals
dosage.child_6_12: 0.5 gm in half glass buttermilk with lunch
dosage.child_under_6: Avoid ajwain powder internally under 6
dosage.elderly: 0.5-1 gm in warm buttermilk once daily
dosage.hindi: Dopehar ke khane ke sath chhaachh mein milakar lein

remedy_text: Consume 10–20 ml Amla juice daily. Apply paste of fruit rind on scalp to prevent hair fall and greying. Also useful for diabetes when combined with turmeric juice.
ayurvedic_note: Rasayana (rejuvenator), balances all three doshas, especially Pitta.

dosage.adult: 10-20 ml fresh juice mixed with equal water every morning on empty stomach
dosage.child_6_12: 5-10 ml diluted juice in the morning
dosage.child_under_6: 2.5-5 ml diluted juice once daily
dosage.elderly: 10 ml diluted juice in the morning
dosage.hindi: Subah khali pet 10-20 ml taaze paani ke sath lein

remedy_text: Boil handful of Tulsi leaves with 5 gm coriander seeds in water, reduce, and take 30 ml thrice daily for fever. Tulsi juice with honey relieves cough and cold.
ayurvedic_note: Sacred herb, balances Kapha and Vata, boosts immunity.

dosage.adult: 30 ml lukewarm decoction thrice daily during acute fever/cough
dosage.child_6_12: 15 ml lukewarm decoction twice daily
dosage.child_under_6: 5 ml with honey twice daily under supervision
dosage.elderly: 20 ml lukewarm decoction twice daily
dosage.hindi: Din mein 2-3 baar gunguna karke 30 ml piyein

remedy_text: Take 2-3 gm of fine Haritaki fruit powder daily with seasonal adjuvants (Anupana): with Rock Salt (Saindhava) in Varsha/Monsoon, Sugar (Sita) in Sharad/Autumn, Ginger (Shunthi) in Hemanta/Early Winter, Long Pepper (Pippali) in Shishira/Late Winter, Honey (Madhu) in Vasanta/Spring, and Jaggery (Guda) in Grishma/Summer.
ayurvedic_note: Tridoshahara, Deepana, Medhya, Rasayana; preserves longevity and cleanses metabolic wastes (Mala shodhana).

dosage.adult: 2-3 gm fine powder with seasonal adjuvant once daily in morning
dosage.child_6_12: 1 gm with seasonal adjuvant once daily
dosage.child_under_6: Avoid purgatives like Haritaki under 6
dosage.elderly: 1-1.5 gm with warm water or seasonal anupana
dosage.hindi: Subah khali pet mausam ke anusaar anupaan ke sath lein

remedy_text: Take 10–15 ml fresh stem juice or 30 ml decoction of Guduchi. Administer with Jaggery (Guda) for Vata & constipation, with Sugar (Sita) for Pitta disorders, with Honey (Madhu) for Kapha, with Castor Oil (Eranda Taila) for Vatarakta/Gout, and with Shunthi for Amavata (Rheumatoid arthritis).
ayurvedic_note: Tridoshashamaka, Vishaghna, Balya, Rasayana; eliminates Ama and cleanses blood.

dosage.adult: 10-15 ml fresh juice or 30 ml decoction twice daily with anupana
dosage.child_6_12: 5-10 ml decoction once daily with honey
dosage.child_under_6: Consult an Ayurvedic physician
dosage.elderly: 15 ml decoction twice daily after meals
dosage.hindi: Din mein 2 baar khana khane ke baad upyukt anupaan ke sath lein

remedy_text: Express 10–15 ml fresh juice from gently warmed Vasa leaves. Blend thoroughly with 5–10 ml raw honey. Consume 2–3 times daily after food.
ayurvedic_note: Tikta-Kashaya rasa, Sheeta virya; specifically alleviates Kapha-Pitta, Kasa, Shwasa, and Raktapitta.

dosage.adult: 10-15 ml warmed leaf juice blended with 5-10 ml honey, 2-3 times daily
dosage.child_6_12: 5 ml juice with honey twice daily
dosage.child_under_6: Contraindicated under 6 years
dosage.elderly: 5-10 ml with honey twice daily after meals
dosage.hindi: Din mein 2 baar khana khane ke baad shahad mein milakar lein

remedy_text: Combine equal parts of Dry Ginger (Shunthi), Black Pepper (Maricha), and Long Pepper (Pippali). Take 1 to 2 gm of this blend mixed with 1 tsp honey before meals.
ayurvedic_note: Katu rasa, Ushna virya, Deepana, Pachana; scrapes away Kapha, clears respiratory channels, and kindles digestive fire.

dosage.adult: 1-2 gm powder mixed with 1 tsp honey before meals twice daily
dosage.child_6_12: 0.5 gm with honey once daily before food
dosage.child_under_6: Avoid pungent Trikatu under 6
dosage.elderly: 0.5-1 gm with honey twice daily before food
dosage.hindi: Khana khane se 15 minute pehle shahad ke sath lein

remedy_text: Take 1–2 gm of powdered Panchakola (equal parts of Pippali, Pippalimoola, Chavya, Chitraka, and Nagara/Shunthi) with warm water or buttermilk twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Potent Deepana-Pachana formulation; eradicates Gulma, Shoola, Anaha, and Kapha-Vata blockage.

dosage.adult: 1-2 gm powder with warm water or buttermilk twice daily after food
dosage.child_6_12: 0.5 gm with warm water once daily
dosage.child_under_6: Contraindicated in young children
dosage.elderly: 0.5-1 gm with warm water twice daily
dosage.hindi: Din mein 1-2 baar gungune paani ke sath khana khane ke baad lein

remedy_name: Shodhita Hingu with Ghee & Warm Water
remedy_text: Fry a pinch (approx. 125–250 mg) of pure Hing in cow's ghee until aromatic. Consume with the first morsel of warm food or mix in warm water with a pinch of rock salt.
ayurvedic_note: Tikshna, Ushna, Vata-Kaphanut; instantly normalizes Apana Vata and relieves colicky pain.

dosage.adult: 125-250 mg shodhita hing fried in ghee with first morsel of food
dosage.child_6_12: A small pinch (approx 50 mg) in ghee with rice
dosage.child_under_6: External hing paste on navel only; do NOT ingest under 2
dosage.elderly: 100-125 mg in warm water or food
dosage.hindi: Ghee mein bhunkar khane ke pehle niwale ke sath ya gungune paani mein lein

remedy_text: Boil 10 gm crushed Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris) fruit in 200 ml water down to 50 ml. Cool slightly, add 1 tsp Mishri (unrefined sugar), and drink twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Madhura, Sheeta virya, Vasti-shodhana; soothes the urinary tract, eliminates Pitta-Vata burning, and acts as a mild diuretic.

dosage.adult: 50 ml warm kwath with 1 tsp mishri twice daily after food
dosage.child_6_12: 25 ml with mishri once daily
dosage.child_under_6: Consult a pediatric doctor
dosage.elderly: 25-40 ml twice daily after food
dosage.hindi: Din mein 2 baar mishri milakar gunguna piyein

condition_name: Burning Sensations, Internal Heat & Bilious Emesis
remedy_text: Soak 10-15 seeded dry grapes (Munakka) in 1 cup of boiled, cooled water overnight. Mash well in the morning, strain, and drink on an empty stomach.
ayurvedic_note: Madhura, Snigdha, Sheeta; immediately subdues aggravated Pitta, relieves Trishna (morbid thirst), and controls burning sensations.
source: Madanapāla Nighaṇṭu, Drākshādi Phala Varga, Sl. 2-5

dosage.adult: 1 cup cold infusion (from 10-15 Munakka) on empty stomach in morning
dosage.child_6_12: Half cup cold infusion (from 5-7 Munakka) in morning
dosage.child_under_6: 3-4 soaked and mashed Munakka water
dosage.elderly: 1 cup cold infusion on empty stomach
dosage.hindi: Subah khali pet raat ki bhigoyi hui draksha ka paani piyein

remedy_text: Extract 30–50 ml fresh juice from peeled, raw Kushmanda fruit. Add a small pinch of powdered Yastimadhu or rock sugar. Consume early morning.
ayurvedic_note: Sheeta, Guru, Basti-shodhaka; powerfully cools systemic Pitta, nourishes tissues (Dhatu-vardhana), and pacifies Amlapitta.
source: Madanapāla Nighaṇṭu, Kushmāndādi Shāka Varga, Sl. 4-8

dosage.adult: 30-50 ml fresh raw juice with a pinch of rock sugar early morning
dosage.child_6_12: 15-25 ml diluted juice in the morning
dosage.child_under_6: 10-15 ml diluted juice under supervision
dosage.elderly: 25-30 ml in the morning
dosage.hindi: Subah khali pet 30-50 ml taaza ras mishri ke sath lein

remedy_text: Boil 1 part roasted puffed paddy/rice (Laja) in 14 parts water until soft. Strain the supernatant liquid, add a pinch of Saindhava salt and roasted Jeera, and serve warm in small, frequent sips.
ayurvedic_note: Laghu, Grahi, Deepana, Dhatu-satmya; provides instant hydration and energy without overloading weak digestive fire.

dosage.adult: 100-200 ml warm laja manda in small frequent sips 2-3 times daily
dosage.child_6_12: 50-100 ml warm gruel water as needed for hydration
dosage.child_under_6: 30-50 ml warm gruel water in small spoonfuls
dosage.elderly: 100 ml warm gruel water twice daily
dosage.hindi: Din mein 2-3 baar halka gunguna karke ghunt-ghunt piyein

remedy_text:
1. Ek chammach Methi dana powder aur aadha chammach Sunthi (Dry ginger) powder milayein.
2. Subah khali pet gungune paani ke sath lein.
3. Jodon par gungune Nirgundi ya Til ke tel ki halke haath se malish karein.
ayurvedic_note: Methi aur Sunthi Vata-Kapha dosha ko shaant karte hain, jodon ki jakdan (Stambha) aur sujan ko door karte hain aur pachan ko theek karte hain.
source: CCRAS Ayurvedic Home Formularies & Classical Treatise

dosage.adult: 1 tsp Methi powder + 1/2 tsp Sunthi powder with warm water in morning; Nirgundi oil massage twice daily
dosage.child_6_12: Gentle external warm oil massage only; powder half dose if prescribed
dosage.child_under_6: External gentle oil massage only; do not administer powder
dosage.elderly: Half tsp Methi + 1/4 tsp Sunthi with warm water; regular gentle oil massage
dosage.hindi: Subah gungune paani ke sath lein aur tel se jodon par halke haath se malish karein

condition_name: Allergic Rhinitis, Sneezing & Nasal Congestion (Vata-Kapha Pratishyaya)
remedy_name: Anu Taila Pratimarsha Nasya & Haridra-Tulsi Bashpa
remedy_text:
1. Subah aur shaam gungune Anu Taila ya shuddh Til ke tel ki 2-2 boond dono naak ke chhidron (nostrils) mein daalein (Pratimarsha Nasya).
2. 4-5 Tulsi ke patte aur ek chauthai chammach Haldi ko 1 litre paani mein ubaal kar uski bhaap (steam inhalation) din mein 1-2 baar lein.
3. Thanda paani aur dhool-mitti se bachein aur gunguna paani piyein.
ayurvedic_note: Anu Taila Urdhwajatrugata rogon (ENT) mein srotas ko kholta hai, kaph ko nikalta hai aur naak ki allergy tatha chheenko ko shaant karta hai.

dosage.adult: 2 drops Anu Taila in each nostril morning/evening; steam inhalation 1-2 times daily
dosage.child_6_12: 1 drop warm sesame oil in each nostril; mild steam under supervision
dosage.child_under_6: Avoid nasal drops in infants under 2; gentle chest warmth only
dosage.elderly: 1-2 drops warm sesame or Anu Taila twice daily; gentle steam inhalation
dosage.hindi: Naak mein 2-2 boond tel daalein aur haldi-tulsi paani ki bhaap lein

remedy_text:
1. Saunth (dry ginger) ya Chandan ka paste banakar maathe par lagayein.
2. 1 chammach Dhaniya seeds ko 1 cup paani mein ubaal kar gunguna piyein.
ayurvedic_note: Pitta aur Vata dosha ko shaant karta hai aur sar ke tanav aur thakan ko door karta hai.

dosage.adult: External paste on forehead; 1 cup coriander infusion warm twice daily
dosage.child_6_12: External Chandan paste on forehead; half cup coriander infusion
dosage.child_under_6: External paste only; ensure rest in quiet room
dosage.elderly: Forehead paste and 1 cup warm coriander infusion after meals
dosage.hindi: Maathe par lep lagayein aur dhaniya ka gunguna paani piyein

remedy_text:
1. Turant aaram se baith jaayein aur pairon ko halka sa uncha rakhein.
2. Ek glass taaze paani mein halka sa nimbu, ek chutki sendha namak aur thodi mishri milaakar ghoont-ghoont piyein.
3. Ek chammach Dhaniya ke beej raat ko paani mein bhigo dein, subah chhaan kar mishri ke sath piyein (Dhanyaka Hima).
ayurvedic_note: Dhanyaka aur Mishri Sheet-virya hone ke karan Pitta aur Vata dosha ko shaant karte hain aur Bhrama (chakkar) ko turant shaant karte hain.

dosage.adult: 1 glass electrolyte lemon water immediately; 1 cup Dhanyaka Hima on empty stomach
dosage.child_6_12: Half glass lemon water with salt and sugar; rest with elevated feet
dosage.child_under_6: Oral rehydration solution in small sips; seek pediatric evaluation
dosage.elderly: 1 glass lemon-salt-sugar water slowly; rest immediately with feet elevated
dosage.hindi: Turant aaram se baith kar nimbu-namak paani piyein aur dhaniya paani subah lein
